$$
\begin{aligned}D=|\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 2 & k\end{aligned}|=7+4k\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{y}=|\begin{aligned}4 & -4 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 3 & 1 & k\end{aligned}| & =4\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -2 \\ 1 & k\end{aligned}|-(-4)\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 3 & k\end{aligned}|+1\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =4(2k+2)+4(0+6)+(0-6) \\  & =8k+8+24-6 \\  & =26+8k.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
y=\frac{{D}_{y}}{D}=\frac{26+8k}{7+4k}.
$$

$$

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+2y+1z=9 \\ 0x+2y+3z=7 \\ -8x+1y+6z=0\end{aligned}
$$

We start finding the determinant of the coefficients matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}D=|\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 \\ -8 & 1 & 6\end{aligned}| & =4\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ -8 & 6\end{aligned}|+1\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -8 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =4(12-3)-2(0+24)+(0+16) \\  & =36-48+16 \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$

Now, let's find $D_x,$ $D_y,$ and $D_z.$

- To find $D_x,$ we take the coefficients matrix, replace the *first* column by the right-hand side of the system, and calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{x}=|\begin{aligned}9 & 2 & 1 \\ 7 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 6\end{aligned}| & =9\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}7 & 3 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}|+1\cdot |\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =9(12-3)-2(42-0)+(7-0) \\  & =81-84+7 \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$

- To find $D_y,$ we take the coefficients matrix, replace the *second* column by the right-hand side of the system, and calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{y}=|\begin{aligned}4 & 9 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & 3 \\ -8 & 0 & 6\end{aligned}| & =4\cdot |\begin{aligned}7 & 3 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}|-9\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ -8 & 6\end{aligned}|+1\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 7 \\ -8 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =4(42)-9(0+24)+(0+56) \\  & =168-216+56 \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$

- To find $D_z,$ we take the coefficients matrix, replace the *third* column by the right-hand side of the system, and calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{z}=|\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 7 \\ -8 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}| & =4\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 7 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 7 \\ -8 & 0\end{aligned}|+9\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -8 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =4(-7)-2(0+56)+9(0+16) \\  & =-28-112+144 \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, the solution to the system is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y,z⟩ & =⟨\frac{{D}_{x}}{D},\frac{{D}_{y}}{D},\frac{{D}_{z}}{D}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{4}{4},\frac{8}{4},\frac{4}{4}⟩ \\  & =⟨1,2,1⟩.\end{aligned}

$$
\left< x,y,z \right> = \left\langle  \dfrac{D_x}{D}, \dfrac{D_y}{D}, \dfrac{D_z}{D} \right\rangle

$$

$$
